description: Server-side services for Codeer.LowCode.Blazor apps. Includes AI document analysis (Azure Document Intelligence + Azure OpenAI), mail sending (SMTP / Microsoft Graph / SendGrid / Gmail), file storage (file system / Azure Blob / S3), external logins (Entra ID / Google / AWS Cognito / OIDC), TOTP two-factor authentication, and ASP.NET Core helpers (hot reload, ETag file responses).
releaseNotes: BREAKING CHANGE: AIChatJobStore and AIChatJobStoreOptions are replaced by AIChatService. It has the same StartAsync / GetStatus / Cancel and takes the agent table (Func<string, IAIChatAgent?>) or a single IAIChatAgent in the constructor; FinishedRetention and MaxRunning are init properties instead of an options object. Hosts rename the type and drop the options object (the app templates keep it as the static AIChatAgentTable.Service). New: semantic search for SemanticSearchField (Codeer.LowCode.Blazor.Extras 0.15.0). The host-facing type is SemanticSearchService, created once per process from the embedding provider (Func<IEmbeddingProvider?>; null means no embedding) and the design data. ApplyAsync(data, isNewData), called from the ModuleDataIO override (CustomizedModuleDataIO.AddAsync / UpdateAsync as in the app templates), adds the embedding vector to the text sent by the field; for a new record without text (bulk import) it builds the text on the server; when the embedding model is not configured or the call fails the text is saved without a vector and a warning is logged. StartReindexAsync / GetReindexStatus / CancelReindex serve the Reindex script of SemanticSearchField as a background job (a thin controller like the AI chat one; see the Example): the start checks that the caller can read the field (same rule as the AI chat), the host supplies the job's ModuleDataIO and connection through SemanticSearchReindexScope, the rows are rebuilt through normal Submit (read and write permissions apply as usual), a page of rows (ReindexPageSize, 100 by default) is embedded in one call, and optionally only the rows that have no vector yet are processed. Vectors are stored as a JSON array text ([0.1,-0.2,...]) that pgvector and SQL Server VECTOR columns cast. The embedding model is an IEmbeddingProvider (ModelId / Dimensions / EmbedAsync(texts)), switchable like the mail senders: the package provides AzureOpenAIEmbeddingProvider with its settings class (AzureOpenAIEmbeddingSettings), plus EmbeddingGeneratorProvider to wrap a Microsoft.Extensions.AI IEmbeddingGenerator; the host picks one by name in a table (see the Example EmbeddingProviderTable and the SemanticSearch.EmbeddingProvider setting) and can add its own implementation. A provider that declares Dimensions makes the indexing fail fast when the returned vectors do not match the database column. New: AzureOpenAIClients.ChatClientFactory(AISettings) builds the IChatClient for Azure OpenAI from AISettings (null when the settings are incomplete); the default constructor of AITextAnalyzeService uses it. RawDataAccessAgent gains an optional constructor parameter semanticSearch (the SemanticSearchService above); when it is set, the embedding provider is configured and the design has a module with a fully configured SemanticSearchField on a PostgreSQL (pgvector) or SQL Server 2025 data source, the agent gets a search_records(moduleName, query, top) tool that embeds the question and lets the database order the rows by cosine distance (ORDER BY ... LIMIT / TOP), returning Id, score, detail page URL and text of the closest rows. There is no in-memory comparison: modules on other databases are not searchable and a failing database search is returned to the model as an error. On the same data sources the agent may write {embed:text} inside an execute_sql query; RawDataAccessToolSet.SqlPreprocessor (a new hook, wired by RawDataAccessAgent) replaces it with the embedding vector literal of that text before the SELECT check, so similarity can be combined with WHERE, JOIN and aggregation in one SQL. The searchable modules are limited to RawDataAccessOptions.DataSourceNames; per-row DataReadCondition is not applied, same as execute_sql. Requires Codeer.LowCode.Blazor.Extras 0.15.0.
